name: azure-monitor-opentelemetry-exporter-java-environment
description: A Java OpenTelemetry runtime for the deprecated Azure Monitor exporter compatibility path with a configured connection string and ingestion egress.

tools.configure_exporter: Configures the Java Azure Monitor OpenTelemetry exporter; adds exporter_configured.
tools.record_span: Records an OpenTelemetry span after the exporter is configured; adds span_recorded.
tools.export_span: Delivers a recorded span to Azure Monitor when ingestion egress is granted; adds telemetry_delivered.
tools.enrich_span: Adds custom attributes or processing to a recorded span; adds span_enriched.

lacks: No secret value is included in this runtime.
